contents_tesim: This is a Judeo-Arabic, probably Karaite translation of North African origin, in Arabic script. The translation was clearly made from a Hebrew original. The text uses the "Maghrebine" form of 1 sg. imperfect (with the n- prefix): e.g., fol. 11v; the letter /f/ sometimes has a dot underneath. The translation is different from both Saadia and Yefet
full_text_tesim: The Arabic undertext runs at a right angle to the overtext
The full number of lines is not always preserved
There are certainly other folios in this palimpsest with text from Genesis, where it is not sufficiently legible to be identified

This is a Judeo-Arabic, probably Karaite translation of North African origin, in Arabic script. The translation was clearly made from a Hebrew original. The text uses the "Maghrebine" form of 1 sg. imperfect (with the n- prefix): e.g., fol. 11v; the letter /f/ sometimes has a dot underneath. The translation is different from both Saadia and Yefet
Translated by the same translator and copied by the same scribe as the UTO Exodus in this manuscript
